[S1]

6. Therefore, for any bulk vertex v ∈ G, the number of distinct tensor network paths from v to the boundary ∂G is finite. [S1]

The holographic isometry Φ: ℋ_bulk → ℋ_{∂G} could map an infinite-dimensional bulk to a finite-dimensional boundary if Φ is not surjective or if it compresses infinite degrees of freedom. T20, T27, T23 only establish boundary finiteness properties, not bulk finiteness. Missing lemma: &#39;If Φ is an isometry and ℋ_{∂G} is finite-dimensional, then ℋ_bulk must be finite-dimensional.&#39; This is not provided in axioms/facts.&quot;,
